in_use.description: Entries use it (it can then only be deactivated).

next_cursor.description:
G24: the next page (same filters), signed and bound to the caller;
null on the last page.

AddrClass.description: What an address is, for P-3.

oneOf.description: Unspecified, multicast, broadcast, link-local or metadata: never.

detached_repos.description: Repositories the App no longer reaches through any installation.

issues_changed.description: Distinct issues changed today that the caller can see now.

AiBudgetNotice.description: An `ai_budget` notification (§3.13.4): amounts are read now, not stored.

budget_usd.description: The current monthly budget, USD as a decimal string (null when unset).

spent_usd.description: Spent this month so far, USD as a decimal string.

hour_resets_at.description: When the oldest run of the last hour stops counting (null when none).

enabled.description: false: the column shows no AI tab.

Applied.description:
The result of `apply-template`: the home and the preferences (the
template also sets shortcuts and the `*` default view).

roles.description: Interface roles in order (empty: the general template).

review_mode.description: Only `detail` in S5 (`queue` and `revise_and_apply` come with S6b).

login.description:
A user's login (what `@login` mentions write, design 06 §6.2, gap
G48); absent for groups.

delegated_projects.description: Unrevoked, unexpired delegations of the built-in AI.

delegations_expire_at.description: The earliest expiry among those delegations.

expiring_soon.description: Within 7 days: the column offers 「延長」.

Blocking.description: One blocking problem: which op, which code, which field (§8.4).

login.description:
A user's login (what `@login` mentions write, design 06 §6.2, gap
G48); absent for groups and everything else.

matched.description: The label that matched (name, login, key or alias).

command_features.description:
Additions to command schema version 1 this server accepts (design 05
§3.10), e.g. "estimated_hours". Clients that do not use one are not
affected.

command_schema_versions.description: Command document versions this server accepts (§4.5).

agent_chain.description:
Design 05 §3.12.4: `depth` (換手過多) or `writes` (寫入次數過多) when
the agent chain limit sent it for review; no counts.

diff.description: Proposed rows only: every changed field with before and after (§15.3).

proposal_hash.description: The hash of `current_version` (a queue tick binds version + hash).

review_modes.description: `["detail"]`, or `["detail","queue"]` when it may be ticked.

rules_changed.description: Contract 05 §3.6.3: the form rules changed since this version.

warnings.description: `evidence_changed` when a citation no longer verifies for you.

diff.description:
G12: every changed field of this version with display values, as the
queue shows it (`before` = the issue now, `after` = proposed,
`original` = when the agent proposed it, G13). Empty with
`content_unavailable`.

rules_changed.description:
Contract 05 §3.6.3: the form rules of the targets changed since this
version was stored (review it in full; it cannot be queue-ticked).

validation.description: The check at creation: codes and statuses only.

evidence.description: Citations (`{citation_id, quote}`); checked for agent proposals (S6).

expected_rules_version.description:
Contract 05 §3.6: the `rules_version` from `describe_form`; when the
rules in force differ, the document fails with `form_rules_changed`.
Not part of the idempotency hash.

ops.description: 1–10 operations, applied in order, all or nothing.

preconditions.description: Exactly one per existing target issue, each with `lock_version`.

effects.description: One per issue the document touched.

time_entries.description: Time entries the document wrote (contract 05 §3.10.2); omitted when none.

labels.description:
The preferred label first, then by label. People who are not
administrators see active labels only.

lock_version.description: Pass back to `PATCH /admin/concepts/{id}`; every label change bumps it.

status.description: active | retired (a retired concept does not expand).

CondInput.description: One condition on a custom field.

value.description:
eq/ne/lt/le/gt/ge: one value. in: an array. between: [min, max], inclusive, either may be null.
is_null/not_null: omit. Numbers for int/float, "YYYY-MM-DD" for date, true/false for bool,
the option label for list, "me"/login/name for user.

status.description:
eventual (free text, no token) | satisfied (the token's write is in the
index) | lagging (it is not yet: no items) | not_applicable (SQL only).

agent_label.description: The agent as history shows it (§16.2), e.g. `claude-code@alice`.

changed_projects.description: Source projects whose settings changed since (the context can no longer be used).

runtime_id.description: Design 05 §3.12.2: the runtime whose roles share this context.

source_projects.description: R: every project ever granted to this context, with the epoch recorded then.

suspended_at.description: Writes paused (§16.6, §16.10): when, and `manual` or the breaker's reason.

state.description: `open` or `read_only` (the AI's work context was replaced).

title.description: What the user typed; empty: show the creation time.

to.description: The new field (created now; values are copied by `start`).

report.description:
`{converted, failed, skipped, failures: [{issue_id, key, reason}]}`:
reason codes (`unmapped`, `unparseable`, `too_long`), never values.

Count.description: R-VD6: a count of visible issues, at most 999 (`capped`: more than that).

truncated.description: Free text only: more matches than the search looks at (8000).

role_key.description: Defaults to the template's (§4.4); required for `personal` and `custom`.

token.description: Shown once; `null` on a replay of the same Idempotency-Key.

enters_triage.description:
Contract 05 §3.4: an issue this caller creates here enters the
project's Triage inbox.

CredentialSummary.description:
G14: one agent token as its sponsor (or a site admin) sees it; never the
token or its hash.

agent_principal_id.description: The role the token acts as.

last_used_at.description:
Last successful bearer authentication, written at most once a
minute; null when never used since 0031.

state.description:
`active`, `revoked`, `expired` or `context_closed` (the work context
was closed: the token no longer works although it was not revoked).

CustomFieldInfo.description:
A custom field as `resolve(kind: "custom_field")` describes it (design
03 §2.4): what a filter on it needs.

definition_version.description:
Pass it in filter conditions to fail with `field_definition_changed` instead of
silently filtering by a changed definition.

options.description: List fields: the options (filter by label; inactive ones still match old values).

type.description: int | float | date | string | text | list | user | bool | link

unit.description: Unit of the stored number (e.g. "hour"), when the field has one: send values in it.

type.description: int | float | date | string | text | list | user | bool | link

value.description: Number, "YYYY-MM-DD", string or bool; list: {id, label, active}; user: {id, name}.

available.description:
The project (for `*`, none) and the view can be read now; one
answer for "deleted" and "not visible".

name.description: A saved view's name, when available.

DefaultViewInput.description:
One default view of `PUT /me/preferences`: the view id, or the object
`GET` returned (`available` and `name` ignored).

agent_client_id.description:
The 02 form: the `personal` role of this client (created, with its
runtime, on first use). Give exactly one of the two.

agent_principal_id.description: Design 05 §3.1: one of the caller's roles (from `GET /ai-team`).

policies.description:
Modes inside the ceiling (§16.3); unlisted commands and fields are
direct, except `log_time` and `update_time_entry` (review, contract 05 §4.3).

read_own_time.description: Contract 05 §3.5.4 A1: let the agent read your own time (default false).

read_own_time_ack.description: Required with `read_own_time: true` (the §6.14 warning was acknowledged).

paused_at.description:
Design 05 §3.12.6: project-level pause of this role (writes refused
with `agent_paused`, reads go on).

read_own_time.description: Contract 05 §2.5, §3.5.4: the agent may read the delegator's own time.

read_own_time_ack_at.description: When the delegator ticked 「我了解，仍要開啟」.

read_own_time_warning.description: The §6.14 warning text (the same on every delegation).

role_key.description: The role (`personal` for delegations made through the 02 path).

runtime_id.description: Design 05 §3.12: the runtime the delegation's context belongs to.

accessible.description: false: the App can no longer read the repository; data is as of `synced_at`.

ci_state.description: pending, success, failure; null = no checks on the current head

synced_at.description: When the link's last full sync finished (null: backfill not done).

DiffRow.description: One changed field as the queue shows it.

has_original.description:
False when no value was recorded for this field: an owner's
revision, a proposal stored before 0031, redacted content, a field
the proposing agent could not read then or you cannot read now, or a
row that is not a field (note, triage, time).

original.description:
G13: the value when the agent proposed this version, rendered like
`before` (null when unset). Meaningful only with `has_original`.

Done.description: An action that returns nothing but success.

base_version.description: The current draft's version, or (no draft) the published version (0: none).

transport.description: Whether this build can reach providers at all (feature `ai`).

address_class.description:
Where it resolves now: `public`, `private`, `loopback`, `blocked`;
null when it does not resolve.

key_configured.description: Whether `OXLEDGER_AI_KEY_<NAME>` was set at start-up. Never the key.

origin.description: `scheme://host[:port]`, never the path's secrets (there are none).

ErrorBody.description: The error object of §4.3 (`{"error": …}` in REST, bare in MCP).

ErrorCode.description:
Stable error codes. Programs depend on these, never on `message`.
Codes of the §4.4 table arrive with the code that produces them.

oneOf.description:
Malformed request: bad JSON, unknown or missing fields, both a cookie
and a bearer token (`details.kind = "ambiguous_credentials"`).
No valid credentials, or the principal behind them is no longer active.
Login failed. Unknown login and wrong password look the same.
The action needs a recent step-up (password re-entry within 15 minutes).
Origin, CSRF token or Content-Type check failed.
Only a person in a browser session may do this (not an agent or a legacy key).
The target is visible but the caller may not do this to it.
Missing, or the caller may not know it exists (same shape for both).
A value in a write request is not allowed; `details.allowed`.
A read tool parameter has a bad value; `details.path`, `details.allowed`.
The custom field `filter` cannot be used (design 03 §3.7).
Tampered or foreign cursor.
A name matches several visible objects; `details.candidates`.

The agent's work context cannot be used: `details.kind` is
`"quarantined"` or `"closed"` (§4.4).
No usable delegation for this project.
Too many attempts; `retry_after_ms`.
Database or another dependency is down for a moment.
`lock_version` does not match; re-read and decide again.
A readable precondition field value does not match.
The same operation id was used with different content.
The same operation is still running.
The stored result of this operation id was purged; it is not run again.
A command or field the first slice does not support.
`exec_mode` other than `atomic`.
A required field is empty in the final state; only readable fields are named.
Workflow or field rules do not allow changing the field.
Not an allowed status; `details.allowed` lists the caller's transitions.
Duplicate of itself, or across projects.

Contract 05 §3.10.1: the issue is not waiting in Triage (or, for
`unsnooze`, not snoozed); `details.state` is its triage state.
The newly chosen version is locked or closed (§17.3 R1).
Deleting a version still used by issues the caller can see (R5).
A version with the same name exists in the project (R8).
Not the current version of the ChangeSet.
The proposal hash does not match, or the content was redacted.
What was reviewed is no longer what would run (§15.3, §15.4).
§16.7: nothing of the execution can be undone now (SPA only).

§19.8: the repository is unknown, not opened for linking, or the App
cannot reach it (one shape for all three).
§19.8: the project already links this repository.
§19.8: the project links 20 repositories already (R-G9).
This version was applied already; `details.execution_id`.
Rejected, canceled or succeeded.
The delegator can no longer read the whole proposal.
The ChangeSet expired.
The write would reach readers outside every source project (§3.8).
An evidence citation did not verify as `valid` (§6.7 step 7).
A citation id cannot be decoded or has an unsupported kind (03 §3.7).
The quote is not what the cited range says (03 §3.6).
A proposal or write quota is used up (§8.9, §16.6).
The circuit breaker paused this agent work context (§16.6).
`q` has non-blank characters but no searchable term (design 03 §3.7).
The search index is broken or its worker stopped (not ordinary lag).
`consistent_after` is not a `c1.<epoch>.<xid>` token (03 §4.11).

The token's data epoch is not the current one (03 §4.3): search
again without it; never re-propose or ask for approval again.
`on_lag: "error"` and the index has not caught up; `retry_after_ms`.
A filter names a custom field definition that changed since (03 §3.7).
The query did not finish within the request's work budget (03 §5.4).

A view definition is not valid (design 05 §5): `details.path`,
`details.reason` (`unknown_field`, `invalid_shape`, `invalid_value`,
`kind_mismatch`, `lanes_required`, `restricted_field`,
`project_scope`, `too_large`, `duplicate_value`).
Another view of the same scope has this name; `details.view_id`.
A project tab still shows this view; `details.tabs` (tab titles).

Contract 05 §3.6: `expected_rules_version` is not the rules version
in force; `details.current`. Describe the form again.

A form draft is not valid: `details.kind` (`unknown_field`,
`restricted_condition_field`, `condition_too_complex`, `cycle`,
`hides_required`, `field_not_applicable`, `malformed`,
`invalid_rule`), `details.path`, `rule_id` or `section_id`.

`mode = block` and existing issues break the rules; `details` is the
impact report.

Design 05 §3.9: the label already belongs (active) to another
concept; `details.concept_id`, `details.pref_label`, `details.label`.

Design 05 §5: a role or delegation for a runtime whose work context
is closed; start a new work context first.

Design 05 §5 (Q2): the agent software already runs in another active
runtime of this sponsor; `details.runtime_id`, `details.label`.

Design 05 §5: the built-in AI cannot run now; `details.kind` is
`disabled`, `circuit_open`, `not_configured` or `endpoint_blocked`.

The AI provider failed; `details.kind` is `timeout`, `http_status`
(with `status`) or `malformed`. Never the provider's own text.
The model or the endpoint's host is on the D17 list; `details.field`.
`details.kind`: `unregistered`, `no_key` or `endpoint_blocked`.
The conversation became read-only (a new work context); start a new one.

The provider in use changed since this conversation's last run;
resend with `ack_provider_id`. `details.provider`.
The caller already has a run queued or running.

Design 06 §5: the body is over a size limit (`POST /markdown/preview`
text, later uploads, imports and wiki pages); `details.limit` in bytes.

ErrorView.description: An error as the owner sees it on a failed execution or a validation.

detail.description:
The event's content as the caller may see it (readable fields only;
ids shown as names). Absent when redacted.

event_id.description:
Opaque id (for `POST /issues/{key}/events/{event_id}/redact`); the
internal sequence number is never returned.

kind.description:
created | fields_changed | status_changed | note_added | duplicate_added
| triage_changed (contract 05 §3.4) | …

search.description: Only when succeeded: the token from the domain transaction (§6.9).

Expansion.description:
One expanded label (`match.expanded`, §3.9): the query piece that
equals a label, the concept (its preferred label) and the other label.

label.description:
The label added to the query; for a hidden label (a misspelling
or internal term) the concept's preferred label instead.

editable.description: Can be changed (for agents: can be changed in a proposal).

reason.description: Why not editable: project_not_writable | not_editable | workflow_readonly.

required.description: Required in the current status (definition or workflow rule).

deactivated.description:
Deactivated: not in describe or forms and takes no new values; old
values stay readable and filterable.

index_state.description: pending (filters work without the index), ready, none (text), dropping.

key.description: `cf:<id>`, the key in command documents and forms.

required_impact.description: `?preview_required=true`, or a PATCH that made the field required.

warnings.description:
PATCH: what the change does not block but the administrator should
know (`restricted_condition_field`: published form rules name the
field in conditions; people who cannot read it are no longer held
to them, agents are blocked).

delegable.description:
The field may be put in an agent delegation's `writable_fields`
(02 §3.5: agents never read or write `visible = false` custom fields).

ops.description: create | update | transition: what the caller could do with the field.

options.description:
List fields: every option, inactive ones marked (they can be kept but
not newly chosen).

options_source.description: Where the valid values come from.

required.description:
The field definition itself is required (workflow rules are per status:
see the issue actions).

type.description:
string | text | date | decimal | principal_ref | priority_ref | status_ref |
version_ref, or a custom field type (int, float, date, string, text, list, user,
bool, link). `decimal` values are decimal strings.

definition_version.description: Custom fields: moves when the type, unit or options change.

dynamic.description:
Dynamic values besides ids: `me` ({"me": true}), `next`
({"next": true}, one project only), `rel` ({"rel": "today",
"offset": n}), `range` (within).

options_source.description:
Larger sets: where to look values up (`GET …/assignees`, `GET
…/versions`, or `POST /api/v1/resolve` across projects).

restricted.description:
Custom fields: true for a field with `visible = false` (only readers
see it; it cannot be used in project views).

type.description:
ref | principal | enum | bool | date | datetime | number, or a custom
field type (int, float, date, string, text, list, user, bool, link).

FilterFields.description:
What can be filtered and sorted (`GET /filter-fields`, MCP `describe`
scope `filter_fields`; design 05 §3.2).

sortable.description: `sort` keys: the built-in ones and sortable custom fields.

today.description: The organization's date (R10), YYYY-MM-DD: what relative dates mean now.

or.description: At least one of these must hold.

FilterInput.description: Custom field filter: a condition, or `{"and": [...]}` / `{"or": [...]}` of filters.

active.description: Priorities and list options: inactive ones still match old values.

id.description: The value to send (an id, or the enum value).

layout.description: A display hint only; every field you may set is in some section.

lock_version.description: op update: the issue's lock_version (for the precondition).

rules_version.description: Send it back as expected_rules_version to detect rule changes.
Effective rules version of this form's layer (site: rN.0…).

policy.description: Agents: `"review"` when writing it sends the document for review.

required.description: Required always (definition, or workflow at the status in question).

FormImpact.description:
`POST /forms/{id}/drafts/{part}/impact` (§3.6.3). Counts only what the
caller can see; sample keys are visible issues.

count.description: null: not counted (out of time, or the run has free text).

value.description: The group's value (an id, a category, true/false), null = not set.

changed.description: false: it was in that state already (no event).

Highlight.description: A highlighted range of a returned `text`, in code points, half-open.

Impact.description: What a date or status change touches, over visible issues only.

becomes_overdue_version.description: The version would turn `overdue` (it was not before).

due_after_new_date.description: Open issues whose due date is after the new version date.

InboxSettings.description: The project's settings as the inbox shows them.

automatic.description: Fields, notes or relations it can restore without a choice.

needs_choice.description: Transitions or "close as created by mistake" to do one by one.

items.description: Newest first: the SPA sends one undo per item, in this order.

IssueActions.description:
What the caller can do to one issue now (§5.2). There is deliberately no
`can_apply`.

IssueBrief.description: One line of an issue list (children of an issue).

allowed_statuses.description: Statuses the caller may move this issue to (workflow), current first.

custom_fields.description:
Custom fields that apply to this issue (tracker and project) and that the
caller may read, in display order; `value` is null when empty.

description_by_agent.description:
`GET /issues/{key}`: the description is an agent's (R-M3); the editor
warns before a person rewrites it (design 06 §6.2).

description_format.description:
`markdown`, or `plain` for a description written before M2 and not
rewritten since (design 06 R-M9). An editor that rewrites a plain
description sends `format: "markdown"` to convert it.

description_html.description:
`GET /issues/{key}` (design 06 R-M10): the description as sanitized
HTML, references resolved for the caller. The only description field
to put in the page as HTML.

estimated_hours.description: Decimal string such as "1.5" (design 05 §3.10.3); null when not set.

form_rule_marks.description:
Contract 05 §3.6.3: rule ids of open `accept_and_mark` marks (the
issue broke rules published after it was written); the next write
that passes the rules clears them. Empty when none.

requested_key.description: Set when the requested key is an old key of a moved issue.

spent_hours.description:
Contract 05 §3.5.4: hours of the time entries on this issue that the
caller can see (others' hidden entries are not counted), such as "6.00";
"0" when none. Absent when the caller cannot read time in the project
(no `view_time_entries`, module off) and always for agents (§4).

triage.description:
Contract 05 §3.4: the Triage state; null when the issue never
entered the inbox.

watch.description:
Contract 05 §3.11.1: whether the caller watches this issue. People
only (agents never watch, §4.6); absent for agents.

merged_open.description:
R-G5: a PR is merged while the issue is not closed (a hint; nothing
changes by itself).

synced_at.description: The oldest `synced_at` of the PRs shown.

truncated.description: More than 20 PRs: the rest are on GitHub.

can_decide.description:
The caller may send a `triage_decide` for it now (`triage_issues`;
for an agent also the delegation's `triage_decide`).

agent_principal_id.description: The role the token acts as (design 05 §3.12.5).

token.description: Shown once; only its hash is stored.

issue_id.description: The issue the op wrote (issue ops).

time_entry_id.description: The time entry the op wrote (time ops, contract 05 §3.10.2).

version_id.description: The milestone the op wrote (version ops).

kind.description: alt | hidden (the preferred label cannot change kind or status).

status.description: active | staging (staging labels are not expanded).

values.description: The lane's values (ids, categories; null = 未設定).

LayoutSection.description: A section of the effective layout (§3.6.1).

show_if.description: A display hint, not a rule (the same condition language as rules).

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` with every non-GET request of this session.

wiki_project.description: A project id or key whose wiki the page is in.

context.description:
What the text belongs to: `{"issue": "AUTH-1"}` (a description or
note of that issue) or `{"project": "AUTH"}` (a new issue).
`{"wiki_project": …}` answers `not_found` until the wiki exists (M2.2).

format_version.description:
The rendering rules' version (1 in M2.1); it changes when the same
text would render differently.

html.description:
Sanitized HTML, references resolved for the caller; put it in the
page as it is (the only `{@html}` source, R-M10).

refs_truncated.description: More than 200 references: the rest are shown as text (R-M7).

id.description:
The row now holding these events (after `unread` merged it into
another unread row of the same issue, that row's id).

merged_into.description:
`unread` joined this row to the issue's other unread row (the old id
no longer exists).

MatchInfo.description: Which fields matched, recomputed from the current text (design 03 §3.4 step 6).

expanded.description:
Design 05 §3.9: concept labels added to the query that occur in
this issue's text (a hidden label shows as the concept's name).
Absent when none.

fields.description:
Of key, subject, description, cf_text (visible text custom fields),
notes (public notes), in that order.

strength.description:
primary: a full term matched (an expanded label's word counts);
fallback: only single CJK characters or identifier parts.

parts.description:
Typed parts (§3.13.5): `text {text}`, `tool_progress {tool, summary,
ok}`, `write {…as the SSE write event}`, `unavailable {reason:
source_revoked|redacted|purged}`, `notice {kind, text}`.

pref_label.description: 1–60 characters; also an active label of the concept (kind pref).

title.description: Up to 120 characters, typed by the user (never made up by the model).

NewFieldInput.description: `POST /admin/custom-fields` (and the new field of a conversion).

ftype.description: int, float, date, string, text, list, user, bool, link.

visible.description: Default true. false: only administrators and holders of `role_ids`.

project.description: Project key or id; omit for the site-level form.

NewProvider.description:
`POST /admin/ai/providers`. Unknown fields (a URL, a key, an environment
variable name) are refused by the schema (T-M1-112).

d17_attested.description: P-1: 「我確認這個模型與服務符合 D17」. Must be true.

input_usd_per_mtok.description: USD per million input tokens, e.g. "3.00".

max_output_tokens.description: The run's total output limit (256–32000, default 4096).

name.description: 1–60 characters, shown to users ("AI 服務已換成〈name〉").

org_account_attested.description: P-6: required when the endpoint resolves to a public address.

isolation_ack.description: "does not share files, memory or credentials with my other runtimes".

def.description: The definition (design 05 §3.3); `def.kind` may be left out.

name.description: 1–60 characters, unique per owner (personal) or project (project).

project_id.description:
Project id or key: required for `project`; optional for `personal`
(binds the view to that project; leave out for a cross-project view).

scope.description: `personal` or `project` (needs manage_public_views in an active project).

NextAction.description:
What the caller may do next (contract 02 §14.2). A closed set; the list
on an error names options, not steps to run in order.

body_format.description: `markdown`, or `plain` for notes written before M2 (design 06 R-M9).

body_html.description:
Web app only (`GET /issues/{key}/view`; never over MCP, design 06
R-M10): the body as sanitized HTML, references resolved for the
caller. The only note field to put in the page as HTML.

ai_budget.description: Set for `kind = ai_budget`: the month's AI spending crossed 80% or 100%.

watching, assigned, author, agent_on_behalf, triage_decided,

R-MN5; on by default). Mentions do not make me watch the issue.

on_triage_decided.description: the Triage outcome of issues I reported,

on_watching.description: Notify me about: issues I watch,

oneOf.description: Contract 05 §3.10.2: log time (with issue ops on the same issue, or alone).

oneOf.description: Contract 05 §3.10.2: the only op, one precondition on the entry.

active.description: false: kept on issues that have it, not offered for new values.

paused_by.description: `sponsor` or `site_admin`: the sponsor and site administrators only.

scope.description: Always `principal` (project pauses are on the policy rows).

PolicyInput.description: Per-command and per-field modes (§16.3). Keys must be inside the ceiling.

PolicyView.description:

the server supports that the delegation lacks are never added by themselves).

field_values.description: Extra conditions on readable fields (normalized values).

Left out of the request fingerprint when absent, so a request sent

default_views.description:
The whole map: project id or `*` → a view id (or the object `GET`
returned).

interface_roles.description: pm, designer, engineer (only defaults, never permissions).

PrincipalRef2.description: An issue's author or a decider; `on_behalf_of` for agents.

allowed_values.description: Values the caller may give explicitly.

default.description: Used when `is_private` is not given (the tracker's default).

items.description: Usable now in the project (site active and not turned off here).

can_manage.description: Whether the caller may hide PRs here (and ask for `include_hidden`).

paused_by.description:

of the project). Only on this policy row, i.e. for the viewers who

module_enabled.description:
Turns the time tracking module on or off (omitted = unchanged). This

from the project must be restarted.

activities.description: The site list, for the settings page.

module_enabled.description: Whether the time tracking module is on.

ProviderPatch.description:
`PATCH /admin/ai/providers/{id}`: the fields to change; the D17

endpoint_registered.description: Whether the endpoint is still registered in this process.

marked.description: Issues marked as not meeting the new rules (accept_and_mark).

before.description:

`last_at` when the list was loaded), so later arrivals stay unread.

ack.description: Required (true) when enabling: the §6.14 warning was acknowledged.

ReadOwnTimeWarning.description:
Contract 05 §6.14: the delegation wizard's warning for `read_own_time`,
word for word (A1(c)). The SPA shows it; the API carries it so the text
has one source.

ack_label.description: The checkbox that must be ticked to turn it on.

tag.description: The tooltip of the delegation list tag 「可讀我的工時」.

reason.description: Why (1–500 characters). Never paste the original text here.

changed.description: False when it was already redacted (nothing written, epoch unchanged).

security_epoch.description: The project's epoch after this call.

paused_until.description: While paused by GitHub's rate limit: when it resumes.

repo_state.description: accessible / inaccessible (the App lost access; data is as of `synced_at`).

synced_at.description: The last full sync (the watermark); null until the backfill finished.

RequiredImpact.description:
Issues the field applies to that have no value: what making it required

kind.description:

operators and `definition_version` of a custom field).

purpose.description:
`assignee`: only who an issue of `project` may be assigned to; more

text.description: Name, login, project key or alias to look up (e.g. "缺陷", "alice", "AUTH").

custom_fields.description: Only with `kind: "custom_field"`: the matching fields the caller may read.

valid_values.description: When nothing matched: valid values for the requested kind.

version.description: The version the preview was made from.

proposal.description: The complete new document (no deep merge, §8.8).

link_id.description: Revoke a whole link (also for PRs on issues you cannot see).

pr_ids.description: Or these PRs (each must be on an issue of this project you can see).

policies.description:
Changes to the template's modes (the confirmation table); keys must
be inside the ceiling.

RuleRef.description: One rule as `describe_form` lists it on its target field.

lane.description:
Board: only this lane (its next page with `cursor`). A board cursor

swimlane.description: Board: only this swimlane value (an id, or `none` for 未設定).

card.description: Board: the card fields (not `key`), plus `overdue`; shapes as `values`.

group.description: List with `group_by`: the item's group value.

swimlane.description: Board with swimlanes: the item's swimlane value.

values.description:
List: one value per column (not `key`), plus `overdue`. People and
groups `{id, name, kind}`; status `{id, name, category}`; tracker,
priority, version `{id, name}`; project `{id, key, name}`; list

RunOverride.description: Narrowing for this run only (not saved).

q.description: Free text; replaces the view's own `query.q`.

where_and.description: A Filter AST v2 ANDed with the view's conditions.

last_event_id.description: The last event id kept by this process (null: none here).

writes.description:
As the SSE `write` events (from the stored messages; from the ids
alone once the conversation was emptied).

shared_with.description: The other active roles sharing the work context and its R.

sources.description: Keys of R (the shared source projects).

time_readers.description: Roles whose active delegation reads your own time (appendix D V10).

fresh_context_ack.description: External runtimes: the "starts without what it read before" declaration.

backfilled.description: Created by the 0029 upgrade from a 02 agent.

changed_projects.description:
Source projects of the active context whose `security_epoch` changed
since they were read (the context is quarantined; start a new one).
What `ContextView.changed_projects` gave before `/agent-contexts`
was removed (M2.0); empty without an active context.

context_id.description: The active work context, if any.

sources.description: Keys of R in the active context.

suspended_at.description:
Writes of the active context are paused (02 §16.6): by the sponsor
(`manual`) or by the incident breaker (`audience_blocked`, …). Lift
with `POST /me/agent-runtimes/{id}/resume`.

allowed_commands.description: Commands not `off` in this project (no fields, no duties).

can_manage.description: The caller may change these settings (`manage_versions`).

SearchEvidence.description: A snippet of the current text and its citation (design 03 §3.6).

evidence_status.description: current | rechecked (the index may still rank by older text; the snippet is from the current text).

field.description:
subject | description | note (a public note; `note_id`). Keys and
custom field values match without a snippet.

highlights.description: Ranges of `text` in code points, half-open.

note_id.description: The note the snippet is from (`field = note`).

text.description: The cited text, verbatim: pass it unchanged as `quote`.

SearchItem.description: One search hit. Only the requested `fields` appear (and `key`).

custom_fields.description: Requested `cf:<name>` fields that apply to this issue and the caller may read.

lock_version.description: As re-checked in SQL (not the index): pass back as a precondition.

rank.description:
With `q`: position across pages (page 2 starts at limit + 1). Compare
rank and `match.strength`; there is no score.

today.description:
The date `overdue` and relative dates were computed with (R10, org
time zone), YYYY-MM-DD.

assignee.description: "me", "none", a user login/name, or a group name.

consistent_after.description:
A write receipt's `search.consistent_after` token: with `q`, wait until
the index includes that write. `search_lagging` is not a write failure:
do not propose again or ask for approval again; use `get` to cite what
was just written.

explain.description:
With `q`: "none" (no snippets), "brief" (default: one ~60-character snippet per issue)
or "full" (up to two ~160-character snippets per matching field).

fields.description:
Fields per item: key, subject, project, tracker, status, status_category, assignee,
priority, is_private, created_at, updated_at, lock_version, cf:<custom field name>.
`key` is always returned. Default: key, subject, project, tracker, status,
status_category, assignee, is_private, updated_at.

filter.description:
Custom field filter, e.g. {"and": [{"field": "Severity", "op": "in", "value": ["High", "Critical"]},
{"field": "Estimate (h)", "op": "between", "value": [2, 8]}]}. Combined with the other filters by AND.

overdue.description:
true: open issues whose due_date is before today (org time zone;
`meta.today`). Not indexed, so no reindex when the day changes.

q.description:
Free text: BM25F over the issue keys (×5), subject (×3), description
(×1), visible text custom fields (×0.7) and public notes (×0.5);
Chinese works without word segmentation. A word (or the whole query)
equal to a concept label also searches the concept's other labels
(`match.expanded`).

sort.description:
Order by up to 3 fields (then id): updated_at, created_at, due_date,
start_date, priority, status, key, estimated_hours, cf:<id>. Default:
updated_at desc without `q`, relevance with `q` (`rank` is still the
relevance position when `sort` is given).

version.description:
Milestone (§17.15): a version id (any readable project), or — only with
`project` — a version name or "next" (else `invalid_filter`,
`reason: project_scope_required`).

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for `consistent_after`, 0–2000 ms (default 1000).

where.description:
Filter AST v2 (design 05 §3.2) over built-in fields (project, tracker,
priority, status, status_category, assignee, author, fixed_version,
is_private, start_date, due_date, created_at, updated_at,
estimated_hours, overdue) and custom fields (`cf:<id>`), e.g.
{"and": [{"field": "status_category", "op": "in", "value": ["todo", "doing"]},
{"field": "assignee", "op": "eq", "value": {"me": true}},
{"field": "due_date", "op": "within", "value": {"range": "next_n_days", "n": 7}}]}.
ANDed with the other parameters. Errors: `invalid_filter` with
`details.path` and `details.reason` (unknown_field, unknown_value,
too_complex, unsupported_op, invalid_value, invalid_shape,
project_scope_required, me_unavailable).

SearchReceipt.description:
Design 03 §4.3: wait for this before expecting search to show the write.
Not a proof of commit; `status` is.

evidence_truncated.description: Some snippets were left out to keep the response small (the item list is still complete).

outcome.description:
"ok", or "search_lagging": the index has not caught up with
`consistent_after` yet. Not a write failure and not "nothing found":
do not propose again or ask for approval again; `get` reads the write.

truncated.description:
Only with `q`: the server stopped after ranking 8000 candidates without
finding everything this page needs. More matches may exist (even if there
is no `next_cursor`); narrow `q` or the filters.

ack_provider_id.description:

conversation to it (`ai_provider_changed`, Q4).

page_context.description: At most 5 references to the pages the user is on.

payload.description:
tabs: `{before, after}` (each `{tabs, default_tab, is_default}`).

updated_at, created_at, due_date, start_date, priority, status, key,
estimated_hours, or cf:<id> of an int, float, date, string or list
field (list: by option position).

agent, or a person applied an agent's proposal; R-M3). The editor

With `description`: `markdown`, or `plain` for a description written
before M2 and not rewritten since (design 06 R-M9).

Web app only (never over MCP, design 06 R-M10): the description as
sanitized HTML, references resolved for the caller. The only
description field to put in the page as HTML.

read-only projection that may lag GitHub by minutes (`synced_at`).

could not be counted in time and the caller's permissions changed
since the last count (show no number).
