conversation content (P2).

command.description: A command document, as for command_submit.

expected_rules_version.description: The rules_version from describe_form; overrides one inside `command`.

rules_version.description: The rules version of the document's targets (null: no issue targets).

would_require_review.description:
Agents: whether command_submit would send it for review (policy).
Always false for people.

checks.description:
structure, visibility, permissions, preconditions, workflow:
`passed`, `failed` or `not_checked`.

deleted.description: Soft-deleted (D-11): the issue keeps pointing at it until changed.

name.description: The current name; show "（已刪除）" after it when `deleted` (§17.14).

VersionFields.description:
A milestone's fields (§17.9a). Absent = not set; `effective_date: null`
clears the date. `status` only in `update_version`.

can_manage.description:
The caller may create and change versions here (`manage_versions`);
the SPA hides those controls otherwise.

VersionSet.description: Absent = unchanged; `effective_date: null` clears the date.

VersionStats.description: Counts over the issues in the version that the caller can see.

no_dates.description: Neither a start nor a due date.

VersionView.description:
A version as §17.8 shows it. `deleted` versions are only returned by
`get`, never by lists or the next-version rule.

VersionWriteResult.description:
The result of a version write. A replay returns the version as it is now
with the stored `execution_id`, `changed` and `impact`.

changed.description: False when nothing differed (no event, no `lock_version` bump).

search.description: §6.9: every successful write carries the receipt (the original one on replay).

project_id.description: Default: the source's project (none for the cross-project built-ins).

ViewDetail.description: `GET /views/{id}` and the result of every view write.

created_by.description: Personal: the owner; project: who created it (not an owner).

def.description:
The normalized definition (design 05 §3.3): ids instead of names;
`me`, `next` and relative dates kept dynamic.

project_unavailable.description:
A personal view bound to a project the caller can no longer see
(left it, or it became private): `project` is left out and a run is
`invalid_view` (reason `project_unavailable`).

payload.description: `{before, after}` (each `{name, def}` or null); `"[已遮蔽]"` once redacted.

columns.description: List: the columns shown (custom fields the caller cannot read are left out).

groups.description: List with `group_by`: the groups of this page's items, in order.

next_cursor.description: List: the next page. Board: always null (each lane has its own).

swimlanes.description: Board with swimlanes: the swimlane values of the items returned.

totals.description: List with `totals`: over every visible match, not only this page.

editable.description: The caller may change it (built-in: never).

id.description:
A uuid, or a built-in id: `builtin:assigned_to_me`,
`builtin:reported_by_me`, `builtin:involving_me`,
`builtin:project_issues:<project id>`, `builtin:project_board:<project id>`.

project.description:
The project it is bound to (project views, project built-ins, and
personal views bound to one project).

project_unavailable.description:
A personal view bound to a project the caller can no longer see
(left it, or it became private): `project` is left out and a run is
`invalid_view` (reason `project_unavailable`).

auto_reason.description: Why the caller watches automatically: author, assignee or note.

opted_out.description:
The caller unwatched this issue: being assigned, writing a note
and so on will not watch it again.

watcher_count.description: Active users who can see the issue now and watch it (at most 100).

field.description:
project, tracker, priority, status, status_category, assignee, author,
fixed_version, is_private, start_date, due_date, created_at,
updated_at, estimated_hours, spent_hours (people only), overdue, or
cf:<custom field id>.

or.description: At least one of these must hold.

WhereInput.description:
Filter AST v2 (design 05 §3.2): a condition, or `{"and": [...]}` /
`{"or": [...]}` of filters. At most 3 levels of and/or, 30 conditions,
100 values per list, 100 different names (ids do not count) and 16 KiB.

WhereOp.description:
`ne` and `not_in` also match issues without a value; `ever_in` (status,
assignee, fixed_version) also matches past values.

available.description:
What it names can be read now. `false` when the view was deleted,
became unreadable or is bound to a project the reader cannot see,
or the milestones project is not readable any more — one answer for
all of them; show "this view no longer exists".

project_id.description:
`milestones`: the project (`GET /projects/{id}/versions?include=stats`);
absent until the person picks one.

type.description: need_decision, view, triage_count, milestones, my_time_week, agent_summary.

view_id.description: `view`: a view id or `builtin:…`; run it with `POST /views/{view_id}/run`.

WidgetInput.description:
One widget of `PUT /me/home`. The read-only fields of `GET /me/home`
(`protected`, `available`, names) may be sent back and are ignored.

id.description:
Keep the id of an existing widget; a new one may leave it out.
1–40 letters, digits, `_` and `-`.

exceeded.description: null when the lane was not counted.

info.description: Browser-session API (contract 02 §4). Cookie only: a bearer token is always unauthenticated. Non-GET requests need Content-Type: application/json, the SPA Origin and X-CSRF-Token. Every response is Cache-Control: no-store.
info.title: oxledger SPA API

get.summary: Endpoints the deployment registered (OXLEDGER_AI_ENDPOINT_<NAME>): origin, address class, whether a key is set. Never the key.
The last 50 changes of AI settings and providers.
AI providers.

post.summary: Add a provider naming a registered endpoint (no URL, key or variable name; unknown fields are refused). D17 confirmation required; the organisation-account confirmation for external services.

patch.summary: Change a provider (lock_version, D17 confirmation again).

post.summary: Retire a provider; retiring the one in use turns the AI off.
Test the connection with a fixed text (no organisation data): key, model, streaming and tool calls.

get.summary: AI settings, budgets, this month's usage and enable_blockers (site administrators).

put.summary: Change AI settings (lock_version). Turning the AI on or off and changing the provider in use need a step-up.

get.summary: Daily and per-person counts, tokens and costs of a month (?month=YYYY-MM); never conversation content.

Concepts and their labels for search alias expansion (design 05 §3.9), by preferred label. Every signed-in person; people who are not administrators see active concepts and their active labels that are not hidden. Query: q (part of a label, NFC + casefold), limit (clamped to 1–100, default 50), cursor.

post.summary: Create a concept (administrators; 201): {pref_label, labels:[{label, kind? alt|hidden, status? active|staging}]}. The preferred label is also an active label (kind pref). Labels are 1–60 characters, compared after NFC + casefold. A label active in another concept: concept_label_taken (409, details.concept_id, pref_label, label). invalid_value kinds: label_invalid, label_kind_invalid, label_status_invalid, duplicate_label, too_many_labels (50).

get.summary: One concept (not_found for a retired one unless you are an administrator).

patch.summary: Rename or retire a concept (administrators): {lock_version, pref_label?, status? active|retired}. A retired concept does not expand; its active labels still hold their names. conflict carries current_lock_version; concept_label_taken as for POST; invalid_value kinds: label_invalid, label_exists, concept_status_invalid.

post.summary: Add a label (administrators; 201): {label, kind? alt|hidden, status? active|staging}. invalid_value kinds: label_invalid, label_kind_invalid, label_status_invalid, label_exists, too_many_labels; concept_label_taken when active in another concept.

patch.summary: Change a label's status (active | staging; staging labels do not expand) or kind (alt | hidden). The path label is matched after NFC + casefold. The preferred label cannot change (invalid_value kind pref_label_fixed). Activating a label active in another concept: concept_label_taken.

get.summary: A conversion's state, batches done and report (counts; failing issue ids and keys with reason codes, never values).

post.summary: Start (or, after failed, resume) copying values in batches of 500 in the background (step-up). Each batch commits its writes with the resume cursor, so a rerun never writes an issue twice; events have system_operation cf_convert:<id>. The old field is not deactivated automatically.

get.summary: Every custom field with its scope, roles, options, lock_version and state (administrators).

post.summary: Create a custom field (administrators; 201). The per-field index is built before the answer; index_state pending means filters work without it. invalid_value kinds: name_invalid, name_taken, ftype_invalid, trackers_required, options_invalid, label_invalid, label_taken, builtin_role, unknown_reference.

delete.summary: Delete a custom field and its values (step-up; query lock_version). 202 with Location: index_state stays dropping until the background delete finishes. conflict (kind conversion_running) while a conversion of it runs.

get.summary: One custom field (id or cf:<id>). Query preview_required=true adds required_impact: the issues the field applies to that have no value.

patch.summary: Change a custom field: {lock_version, set:{name?, description?, is_required?, is_for_all?, project_ids?, tracker_ids?, visible?, role_ids?, position?, deactivated?}}. conflict carries current_lock_version. set.ftype is unsupported_operation (details.suggested conversion). Visibility and scope changes quarantine agent contexts (security_epoch). Making the field required answers with required_impact.

post.summary: Q-S9 type conversion, step 1: {to: a new field definition, mapping}. Creates the new field and the conversion (previewed) and reports how many values convert and which issues would fail (count and sample keys you can see). Nothing is copied yet. Unsupported pairs: unsupported_operation; a bad mapping: invalid_value (kind mapping_invalid).
Add an option to a list field: {label, position?} (201).

delete.summary: Delete an option no issue uses (query lock_version); in use: invalid_value (kind option_in_use), deactivate it instead.

patch.summary: Rename, reorder or (de)activate an option: {lock_version, label?, position?, active?}. An inactive option stays on issues that have it.

get.summary: Forms of the site (no query) or of a project (query project: key or id). Site: administrators; project: administrators or manage_project in an active project.

post.summary: The form of {tracker_id, project?}, created when missing (naturally idempotent; no Idempotency-Key).

get.summary: Installations of the GitHub App and their repositories, with the linkable switch (administrators).

put.summary: Open or close repositories for linking (administrators). Closing keeps existing links.

Replace the site activity list (administrators). An activity left out is deleted unless entries use it (invalid_value kind activity_in_use: deactivate it instead). At most one default, and it must be active (kinds default_count, default_inactive, name_invalid, name_taken, unknown_id).

get.summary: Agent software that can be delegated to.

post.summary: Revoke an agent token.

get.summary: Your agent's direct writes, applied proposals, refusals and undos, newest first by (at, id) (§16.10). Query from, to (RFC 3339, inclusive; default the last 30 days), issue (a key; refusals are left out), cursor (next_cursor of the previous page, same filters), limit (1-200, default 50). Only issues you can read now; what you cannot read counts toward neither the page nor the cursor.

post.summary: Freeze the list of your agent's executions since a time (§16.7): newest first, each marked automatic or needs_choice. Send one undo per item, in order; pausing the agent first is advised.

get.summary: The AI team the caller may see (?project=, ?handle=); numbers count only what the caller can read.

post.summary: Create a role bot: runtime, role, delegations and its first token (shown once; null on a replay). Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Role templates (full allow-lists; unlisted commands and fields are off).
One role: fields depend on the viewer (duties and runtime for the sponsor and site admins only).
The role's writes, filtered to what the caller can read. Same query as GET /agents/{id}/activity: from, to, issue, cursor, limit.

The role's tokens in every work context, newest first: id, label, created, expires, last used (at most once a minute), revoked and state; never the token or its hash. The sponsor and site administrators; a role you cannot see is not_found, one you see as a project member is forbidden_op not_sponsor.

post.summary: New token for the role in its runtime's active context (sponsor; shown once).
Pause the role (scope principal: sponsor or site admin) or its delegation in one project (scope project: also that project's managers; reason required).
Resume the layer you may resume, after re-checking the context and a usable delegation.
Retire the role for good: its delegations and tokens are revoked (sponsor).
Set up your built-in AI (runtime, oxledger-ai@<login> and its first work context); delegations are then created with POST /delegations {agent_principal_id}.
Replace every live delegation of the built-in AI with a new one with the same policies and a new 30-day term.

get.summary: Your conversations, newest activity first (?cursor=, ?limit= 1–100). Nobody else's, administrators included.

post.summary: Start a conversation in the assistant's active work context (title optional, typed by you).

delete.summary: Delete a conversation and its content (not undoable); writes the AI made stay.

get.summary: The conversation's messages as typed parts, re-checked for you now (unavailable placeholders); tool results are never returned.

post.summary: Send a message (1–8000 characters, up to 5 page references, ack_provider_id after ai_provider_changed). Idempotency-Key. 202 with run_id and stream_url.

get.summary: One of your runs: state, stop_reason, usage and cost, writes, last_event_id.

post.summary: Stop the run: no further model or tool calls; writes already made stay.

get.summary: text/event-stream of the run (run.started, text.delta, tool.started, tool.finished, write, notice, run.finished; `: ping` every 15 s). Last-Event-ID resumes; resync when the events are not kept here. At most two connections.
Whether the AI tab is shown (enabled), the provider in use, your assistant (delegated projects, context state, the earliest delegation expiry and expiring_soon within 7 days) and your limits.

post.summary: Sign in; sets the __Host-ox_session cookie.

get.summary: Login challenge; sets the __Host-ox_login cookie.

post.summary: End this session.
Step-up: re-enter the password.

get.summary: Current identity, CSRF token and capabilities.
Own sessions (no tokens).

delete.summary: End one of the own sessions.

get.summary: Your proposals, newest first (§8), 50 per page. Query bucket=awaiting_me (default: proposed or failed) or all; state; group (a group id); cursor. Proposed rows carry the field diff, warnings and review_modes (queue when it may be ticked, §15.3).

A proposal: state, its current version, the last execution (owner only). diff: every changed field with display values as in the queue list (before = now, after = proposed, original = when the agent proposed it when has_original).

post.summary: Approve and apply a version (§8.6). Header Idempotency-Key. 200 with the execution (also when it failed); 202 with Location while the result is not known: resend the same request.
Cancel a proposal not yet applied. Header Idempotency-Key.
Reject the current version (final). Header Idempotency-Key.

Store the previewed revision as your version, approve and apply it in one step (§15.4). Header Idempotency-Key. Answers like approve-and-apply; review_outdated (409) when an issue changed since the preview.
Resolve a conflict field by field (§15.4): keep the issue's current value or the proposed one. Returns the complete revised document and a short-lived revision_review_token. Writes nothing.
Write a new version yourself within what the agent was allowed (§8.5). Header Idempotency-Key.
Check the current version now, without writing (§8.5).

get.summary: One version of a proposal (owner only).

post.summary: Run a command document now (human_direct, §6.8). Header Idempotency-Key: a uuid; resending it returns the same result.

Check a command document as POST /commands would, without writing (design 05 §3.6.4). Read-only: CSRF, no Idempotency-Key. Body {command, expected_rules_version?}. Rejections (not_found, forbidden_op, invalid_request, form_rules_changed) come back as errors; anything else as items[].errors with outcome invalid. would_require_review is always false for people.

get.summary: Own delegations.

post.summary: Delegate a project to an agent (creates its first work context if needed).

get.summary: A delegation's write policies (direct / review / off per command and field) and operations that could be added.

put.summary: Change modes or add commands / fields (needs a step-up; policy_version + 1).

Let the agent read your own time or stop it (design 05 §3.5.4 A1, §6.14). enabled true needs ack true (invalid_value kind ack_required). The response carries read_own_time_warning, the wizard's warning text.

post.summary: Revoke a delegation (only that project).

get.summary: An execution of your approval. Never starts anything.

post.summary: Undo what is still restorable, re-checked under the locks (§16.7). Header Idempotency-Key. A new human_direct execution with reverts_execution_id. undo_not_applicable (409) when nothing can be restored or the subset breaks a rule.

get.summary: What undoing one of your agent's executions (or your undo) would restore now (§16.7): per field before, after, current and whether it can be restored (reasons changed_since, value_no_longer_valid, permission, redacted, expired); notes to retract, relations to remove, transitions to choose. Writes nothing.

What search's `where` and `sort` take (design 05 §3.2): fields, ops, options or options_source, dynamic values, sortable keys, today and week_start. Query project=<id or key> limits to one project (unknown or invisible → not_found).
A form with its published and draft rules and layout and the version strings.

put.summary: Replace the draft of part rules or layout: {base_version, body}. base_version is the current draft's version, or the published version when there is no draft (conflict with details.current_version otherwise). The new draft gets the next version number. form_invalid (details.kind: unknown_field, restricted_condition_field, condition_too_complex, cycle, hides_required, field_not_applicable, malformed, invalid_rule; details.path, rule_id or section_id).

post.summary: Drop the draft (not_found when there is none).

What publishing the draft would do: for rules, existing issues that break it (scan limit 20000; complete false above it), pending proposals that would fail and agent changes whose undo would stop applying (counts of what you can see); for a layout, layout_warnings only.

Publish the draft (step-up): {draft_version, mode}. Rules: mode block (form_publish_blocked with the impact when any issue breaks the rules or the scan was incomplete) or accept_and_mark (issues that break them get form_rule_marks, cleared by their next write that passes). Layout: no mode; changes layout_version only.
Publish an earlier version again under a new version number (step-up): {part, to_version, mode?}. Rules run the impact and honour mode as a publish does.

get.summary: Every version of a part (query part: rules, default, or layout), newest first.
The home cards (§16.10): issues each of your agents changed today (as you can see them now) and contexts the breaker suspended.

The template of roles=pm,designer,engineer (comma list, order matters; none = the general template) as data for "preview as role": widgets, nav_shortcuts, default_views. Changes nothing; the browser renders it with the caller's own permissions.

post.summary: Find issues the caller can see (filters, custom field filter, free text).

get.summary: One issue by key, read from the database (not the index).
What the caller can do to this issue now: editable fields, transitions, notes, duplicate (describe, dynamic).

Pull requests of one issue (R-G9: at most 20, open then draft then the rest, newest first) with review and CI roll-ups, merged_open (R-G5) and synced_at. not_found like the issue when you cannot see it.

post.summary: Redact an issue event (its payload); event_id comes from recent_events. §7.5 D12 redaction (manage_project of the project or a system administrator; human session; step-up within 15 minutes). One transaction: the project's security_epoch + 1 (agent contexts that read it are quarantined), the text replaced by [已遮蔽], a redaction record without the original, and the derived copies (every proposal content and group label of proposals to or from the project, execution before/after values). Already redacted → changed=false. reason_code: personal_data, confidential, legal, other; reason 1–500 characters, never the original text. Header Idempotency-Key.

Redact a note (not_found when you cannot read it). §7.5 D12 redaction (manage_project of the project or a system administrator; human session; step-up within 15 minutes). One transaction: the project's security_epoch + 1 (agent contexts that read it are quarantined), the text replaced by [已遮蔽], a redaction record without the original, and the derived copies (every proposal content and group label of proposals to or from the project, execution before/after values). Already redacted → changed=false. reason_code: personal_data, confidential, legal, other; reason 1–500 characters, never the original text. Header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: The issue page: every get field (priority, fixed_version, status_since…), the full detail (dates, author, children, custom fields, allowed statuses), the ids an edit form sends back, and the optional blocks. Query include (comma list of actions, recent_notes, recent_events, dev), note_limit (0-10), event_limit (0-20). Design 06 R-M10: description_html and each recent note's body_html are sanitized HTML with references resolved for the caller (the only fields to put in the page as HTML); description_by_agent marks an agent's description (stricter link rules). not_found for invisible and missing issues alike.

delete.summary: Stop watching the issue; later assignments or notes do not watch it again automatically (GET /issues/{key} watch.opted_out). Naturally idempotent.

put.summary: Watch the issue yourself (design 05 §3.11.1); it also clears an earlier unwatch, so automatic watching applies again. Only issues you can see (not_found otherwise, exactly as for a missing key). Body {}; naturally idempotent: no Idempotency-Key. watcher_count counts active users who can see the issue now (at most 100; watcher_count_capped). There is no watcher list (B-24).

post.summary: Design 06 §3.2, R-RF6: render text the way stored descriptions and notes render, references resolved for you; writes nothing, notifies nobody, no Idempotency-Key. context: exactly one of {issue: key}, {project: id or key}, {wiki_project} (not_found until the wiki exists, M2.2); a context you cannot see is not_found exactly like a missing one. format: markdown (default) or plain. text over the description limit (262144 bytes) is payload_too_large (details.limit). At most 60 previews a minute per person (rate_limited).

get.summary: Your runtimes, their roles, shared sources and time readers.

post.summary: Start a new work context for the runtime: every role's delegations and tokens are revoked; R starts empty.

Lift a pause of the runtime's active work context, manual or by the incident breaker (needs a step-up; re-checks R's epochs and that a delegation is usable: context_unavailable with details.kind quarantined, delegation_unavailable).
Retire an external runtime: its context closes and its roles retire.
Pause the writes of the runtime's active work context, for every role of the runtime (reads go on). not_found without an active context.

get.summary: The caller's home widgets (design 05 §3.8). need_decision is protected. Each widget says available: false when the view it runs or the milestones project cannot be read now (deleted, not visible, project left — the same answer); names only when available. Data comes from the endpoints of §3.8 (POST /views/{id}/run, GET /triage/counts, GET /projects/{id}/versions?include=stats, GET /me/timesheet, GET /home/agent-summary).

put.summary: Replace the caller's widget list (at most 12). Header Idempotency-Key; lock_version as read from GET /me/home. invalid_value kinds: protected_widget_missing (need_decision cannot be removed), duplicate_protected_widget, too_many_widgets, unknown_widget_type, invalid_widget_id, duplicate_widget_id, width_out_of_range (1–3), limit_out_of_range (view, 3–20), view_required, invalid_view_id (over 80 characters), unexpected_property, unknown_view, unknown_project. A view or project kept unchanged from the stored widget is accepted even if no longer available. conflict carries current_lock_version and current.

post.summary: Apply the interface roles' template (Header Idempotency-Key): mode replace takes the template's widgets (the caller's need_decision stays), shortcuts and * default view; merge only adds what is missing (up to 12 widgets). Templates of several roles are taken in turn, at most 8 widgets. Returns the home and the preferences.

get.summary: The caller's notification settings (design 05 §3.11.4): what to be notified about (on_watching, on_assigned, on_author, on_triage_decided, on_my_agents, on_self, on_mentioned — design 06 R-MN5) and what to watch automatically (auto_watch_author, auto_watch_assignee, auto_watch_note), plus muted project ids (only projects the caller can see now). The first read creates the defaults; no Idempotency-Key. No email in M1.

put.summary: Change the caller's notification settings. Header Idempotency-Key; lock_version as read; fields left out stay; muted_projects replaces the whole list (at most 200 project ids, each visible to the caller). conflict carries current_lock_version and current. invalid_value kinds: unknown_project (missing and not visible are one answer), too_many_projects.

get.summary: The caller's own preferences (design 05 §3.8): interface roles (defaults only, never permissions), onboarded, theme, density, left-nav shortcuts, default views per project id (* = every other project). The first read creates them from the general template; no Idempotency-Key. Shortcuts and default views carry available (the project and view can be read now; deleted and not visible read the same, with only the stored id); send them back unchanged to keep them. There is no endpoint for anyone else's preferences.

put.summary: Change the caller's preferences. Header Idempotency-Key; lock_version as read; fields left out stay. nav_shortcuts and default_views replace the whole list / map; a default view is a view id or the object GET returned; view ids are stored canonical. conflict carries current_lock_version and current. invalid_value kinds: unknown_role, invalid_theme, invalid_density, too_many_shortcuts, unknown_shortcut_kind, view_required, unexpected_property, duplicate_shortcut, unknown_view, too_many_default_views, duplicate_default_view, invalid_view_id (over 80 characters), unknown_project, invalid_default_view (unknown_view and unknown_project do not tell missing from not visible).

get.summary: The caller's own time for one ISO week (design 05 §3.5.2): query week=YYYY-Www (default this week). Rows are (project, issue, activity); days follow org week_start.

The caller's notifications (design 05 §3.11.3), newest arrival first. Query: filter (unread, default; all), project (key or id; one the caller cannot see gives an empty list), limit (clamped to 1–100, default 50), cursor. Every row is checked again with the caller's permissions now: a row with nothing readable is left out without a trace; events show only what the issue history would show the caller (newest 3, more_events counts the rest; note_excerpt is the first 140 characters). A page may have fewer items than limit while next_cursor is set.

post.summary: Mark every unread row whose last_at is at or before {before} as read (send the first row's last_at from when the list was loaded, so later arrivals stay unread). Naturally idempotent: no Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: The bell (design 05 §3.11.3): unread rows with something readable now, at most 99 (capped: show 99+). Counted within 2 seconds, else stale: true with the last count, or count: null when the caller's permissions changed since (show no number). Poll every 60 s while the tab is visible and on focus.

post.summary: Mark one row read. Another person's id and a row with nothing readable now are not_found. Naturally idempotent: no Idempotency-Key.

Mark one row unread. When the issue already has another unread row, this row's events join it and the answer is that row's id with merged_into: true (this id stops existing). Naturally idempotent: no Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: What one of your Idempotency-Keys did.
The organization's default health thresholds and their lock_version.

put.summary: Change the organization defaults (a system administrator). Header Idempotency-Key. lock_version must match (conflict).

get.summary: The timelog rules (design 05 §3.5.3): max_hours_per_day ("0" = no limit), accept_0_hours, accept_future_dates, accept_closed_issues, require_issue, require_comments, lock_version.

put.summary: Replace the timelog rules (administrators). conflict carries details.current and current_lock_version.

get.summary: The projects whose issues you can see (the read scope of search), ordered by key.
Users (and groups, when enabled) an issue in this project may be assigned to.

The development tab: issues of this project with PRs, newest PR activity first, only issues you can see, never a total. Query filter (all, ci_failure, review, merged_open), include_hidden (managers), cursor.

delete.summary: Show a hidden PR again (manage_project). Header Idempotency-Key.

post.summary: Hide a PR in this project only (manage_project). Header Idempotency-Key. not_found unless the PR names an issue of this project you can see. Not a redaction: agents that read it stay valid.

Revoke GitHub content (§19.9; manage_project or administrator; step-up): link_id unlinks a whole link, pr_ids hides PRs you can see. Bumps the project's security_epoch, so every agent context that read the project is quarantined. Header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: GitHub repositories linked to the project (§19.7): full_name, is_private, repo_state (inaccessible = the App lost access; data is as of synced_at), sync_state (backfilling, ok, paused), synced_at, paused_until.

post.summary: Link a repository (manage_project, active project). Header Idempotency-Key. repo_not_linkable (unknown, not opened, or unreachable: one shape), repo_already_linked, repo_link_limit (20). Starts with sync_state backfilling.

get.summary: Repositories you may link here (manage_project): opened by an administrator, reachable by the App, not linked yet.

delete.summary: Unlink (manage_project or administrator; works when the repository is gone or closed for linking). Header Idempotency-Key. Removes that link's refs to this project's issues only.

get.summary: The health thresholds in use (§17.12): effective values, source org or project, both layers and lock_version.

put.summary: Change the project's thresholds (manage_versions). Header Idempotency-Key. lock_version must match (conflict). With inherit_org true leave both values out; otherwise send both, null turns a rule off.

get.summary: The settings history, newest first (manage_project). PR hide/unhide and PR-based revocations are only listed for a system administrator. Query cursor.

post.summary: Redact a project setting event (§18.2; pr_hidden / pr_unhidden: administrators only). §7.5 D12 redaction (manage_project of the project or a system administrator; human session; step-up within 15 minutes). One transaction: the project's security_epoch + 1 (agent contexts that read it are quarantined), the text replaced by [已遮蔽], a redaction record without the original, and the derived copies (every proposal content and group label of proposals to or from the project, execution before/after values). Already redacted → changed=false. reason_code: personal_data, confidential, legal, other; reason 1–500 characters, never the original text. Header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: The project's shared tab bar (§18): built-in views (timeline, milestones, issues, dev, plan, board, triage; triage hidden by default), saved queries, links and project views (kind view, view_id), the default tab, is_default, lock_version and can_manage. Project-public content.

put.summary: Replace the whole tab list (manage_project, active project). Header Idempotency-Key. New saved queries, links and view tabs leave id out; keep the id of existing ones. A view tab (kind view) names a project view of this project in view_id; the built-in board may name a project board view. invalid_value kinds: builtin_missing, duplicate_id, unknown_id, tab_limit, tab_title_taken, tab_title_invalid, tab_query_scope, tab_query_syntax (with position), tab_url_invalid, tab_default_invalid, tab_view_invalid. conflict carries the current settings.

post.summary: Back to the seven built-in tabs (triage hidden), default timeline, is_default true (manage_project). Header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Run a saved query tab as an ordinary search with your own visibility (R-T6): no stored results, no total. Query cursor.
A project's time settings: module_enabled, activity overrides, lock_version, the site activities and can_manage.

put.summary: Replace the project's activity overrides and optionally turn the time tracking module on or off (manage_project, active project). conflict carries details.current and current_lock_version. Turning the module on or off changes the project's security epoch.

get.summary: Whom the caller may log time for in the project: themself, plus (with log_time_for_other_users) active members who may log time.

The schedule view (§17.8): one lane per version (by date, deleted ones only when you see an issue in them) plus the lane without a version. Query from, to (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 400 days; one end alone keeps the computed other), versions (ids or none), include_closed, cursor (pages one lane, 200 items). Only issues you can see count anywhere.
Fields, ops and creation rules of an issue in this project × tracker (describe, static).

The issue form (describe_form, design 05 §3.6.1). Query op (create, default; update) and issue (op update: the key). Fields you cannot read are left out, and so are rules about them; layout is a display hint (show_if is evaluated in the browser with api/form-conformance.json); rules_version goes back as expected_rules_version.

The project's Triage inbox (design 05 §3.4): settings {enabled, responsible, decline_status}, can_decide, and the pending issues the caller can see, oldest entered first (none while Triage is off). Query include_snoozed (default false), cursor, limit (1-100, default 50). view=decided: decisions of the last 30 days, newest first, each with decision, decided_by (agents: on_behalf_of), decided_at, self_triage, same_sponsor; filters self_triage=only|exclude|all (only = self_triage or same_sponsor) and decided_by_kind=agent|user|all. Decide with POST /commands (op triage_decide).
Triage settings of a visible project: enabled, entry_rule (creator_without_triage | all_new), responsible, decline_status, lock_version, can_manage.

put.summary: Replace the Triage settings (manage_project, active project). Header Idempotency-Key. responsible_user_id: an active assignable user of the project; decline_status_id: a done status, required when enabled. invalid_value kinds: triage_entry_rule, triage_decline_status_required, triage_decline_status_invalid, triage_responsible_invalid. conflict carries details.current and current_lock_version. With enabled true, warnings (kind decline_transition_missing) name roles with triage_issues and no workflow transition from a tracker's initial status to the decline status; they do not block.

get.summary: Versions of a project (§17.8). Query status=open,locked (default), include=stats,next.

post.summary: Create a version (manage_versions). Header Idempotency-Key.
Name, login, key or alias to ids the caller can see.

get.summary: With project=<id or key>: the activities usable there now and default_id. Without: the site list (id, name, position, active, is_default, in_use).

Time entries the caller may read (design 05 §3.5.2, §3.5.4), newest first by (spent_on, created_at, id). Query project (id or key), issue (id or key), user (id or me), activity, from, to (YYYY-MM-DD), cursor, limit (1-200, default 50). Visibility: view_time_entries with time_entries_visibility all, or own and the entry is yours; an entry on an issue you cannot see is left out. Write with POST /commands (log_time, update_time_entry, delete_time_entry).

Totals of the time the caller may read (design 05 §3.5.2). Query from and to (required, at most 366 days), group_by user|activity|issue|tracker|fixed_version|day|week|month (default user), project, user, issue. scope_note is always only_visible. forbidden_op reason time_entries_not_visible when no visible project gives view_time_entries.
One time entry with can_edit and can_delete (design 05 §3.5.1); not_found when not visible.
History of a visible time entry, oldest first: kind created|updated|deleted|restored, origin, actor, changes {field: {old, new}}.

post.summary: Redact a time entry's comments (design 05 §2.5 D12). Same rules as the other redactions: manage_project of the project or a system administrator; human session; step-up within 15 minutes; an entry you cannot read is not_found. One transaction: the project's security_epoch + 1, the comments and every event that holds them replaced by [已遮蔽] (time_entry.redacted = true), one redaction record per such event, and the derived copies (as for notes, plus execution_time_entry_changes). Already redacted → changed=false. Header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Every project where the caller has triage_issues and Triage is on, one inbox (each item has project). Query include_snoozed, cursor, limit.
Pending (not snoozed) issues the caller can see per project of GET /triage; count stops at 99 with more true.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a version (manage_versions, R5). Query lock_version; header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: One version with stats and health over the issues you can see.

patch.summary: Change a version (manage_versions). Header Idempotency-Key; returns the impact of date or status changes.

get.summary: Version history, oldest first. Query cursor, limit.

post.summary: Redact a version event (§17.13). §7.5 D12 redaction (manage_project of the project or a system administrator; human session; step-up within 15 minutes). One transaction: the project's security_epoch + 1 (agent contexts that read it are quarantined), the text replaced by [已遮蔽], a redaction record without the original, and the derived copies (every proposal content and group label of proposals to or from the project, execution before/after values). Already redacted → changed=false. reason_code: personal_data, confidential, legal, other; reason 1–500 characters, never the original text. Header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: Preview a change (manage_versions). Query effective_date (empty clears), status.

Views you can open (design 05 §3.3): built-ins (without project: assigned_to_me, reported_by_me, involving_me; with project: project_issues and project_board of that project), your personal views, and the project views of visible projects. Query project (id or key), scope (all, builtin, personal, project), cursor, limit.

post.summary: Save a view. Header Idempotency-Key. scope personal (yours; project_id optional) or project (manage_public_views in an active project; project-public, no restricted fields, R-VD3). Errors: invalid_view (details.path, reason: unknown_field, invalid_shape, invalid_value, duplicate_value, kind_mismatch, lanes_required, restricted_field, project_scope, too_large), invalid_filter (in def.query.where), invalid_value (kinds view_name_invalid, view_limit, project_required, invalid_kind, invalid_scope), view_name_taken (details.view_id), forbidden_op (manage_public_views).
Run an unsaved definition with the checks of saving it as scope (personal or project) in project_id. Same result as run; not saved, no Idempotency-Key.

delete.summary: Delete a view (soft). Header Idempotency-Key, query lock_version (required). A project view a project tab shows is view_in_use (details.tabs: the tab titles); remove the tab first.

get.summary: One view: uuid or built-in id (builtin:assigned_to_me, builtin:reported_by_me, builtin:involving_me, builtin:project_issues:<project>, builtin:project_board:<project>). Someone else's personal view, or a project view of a project you cannot see, is not_found.

patch.summary: Rename and/or replace the definition (def replaces the whole def; the kind stays). Header Idempotency-Key. lock_version required; conflict carries details.current and details.current_lock_version. Built-in views: forbidden_op (builtin_view). Project views: manage_public_views.

post.summary: Copy any view you can open (built-ins too, except builtin:involving_me: forbidden_op not_copyable) into a new independent personal or project view. Header Idempotency-Key.

get.summary: The view's change history, newest first (whoever can open the view). Redacted events show [已遮蔽]. Query cursor.

post.summary: Run a view with your own visibility (K3). List: items with values, groups and totals over every visible match; board: lanes with their items, counts (at most 999, capped), wip and next_cursor (a board cursor goes with its lane). Counts and totals are null when out of the 2 s budget or with free text. override.q replaces the view's q; override.where_and narrows. A saved condition on a field you cannot read is invalid_filter (field_unavailable). POST so long cursors fit.
